what: When a hand enters over the same section as the carousel, an 88px round guide circle (drag-hand drawing plus ‹Swipe›) turns on in .5s and glides to each mouse position over .5s power4.out. The following feel comes from a fresh tween set on every move. Outside the section the position is still recorded, so it turns on right at the cursor position when re-entering. The circle is a three-stop vertical gradient of the accent color. With look: pop, the outer frame only follows the cursor and the inner face turns on with scale 0 → 1 instead of opacity in a .7s cubic-bezier(.4,0,.2,1) transition, and sits offset from the cursor by shift-x and shift-y (new products row of a shop site: white 75px circle, left-right triangles, upper right 60%, follows at 1s power3)

options.ease: Follow curve, default power4.out("0.16,1,0.3,1" Even the same figure)
options.--fx-disc-bg: Circle fill, default accent color three-stop gradient
options.look: If pop, uses the inner face [data-fx-part instead of opacity=face] scales on from 0 → 1 and back off (the face holds the fill — a frame that is transparent outside). Check that it turns on each time the pointer moves over the section
options.shift-x: look: pop — how many % of its own width to offset the plane to the right of the cursor center, default 0 (Brand 60)
options.shift-y: look: pop — what percent of its own height to move down (− means up), default 0 (Brand -60)
options.[data-fx-part=face]: look: inner face of pop (child of disc) — put the fill · artwork here
options.--fx-pop-ease: look: pop scale curve (css variable), default cubic-bezier(.4,0,.2,1) — duration is --fx-fade (default .7s for pop)
